tower.environments.v1alpha1.BoxSpec.description: BoxSpec is what workstream wants. What the box is made of cannot change: a different recipe is a different box.

addons.description: Add-ons layered onto the image, in this order: "browser" or "desktop", workstream's (docs/decisions/box-addons.md).

checkouts.description: The repositories to check out: the first at /workspace, each other at /repos/<repository>. Empty is an empty box, which needs image. The first's devcontainer is the box's image unless image or image_build is set, read as workstream reads it (docs/decisions/devcontainers.md).

fallbackImage.description: The image the box is made of when its first checkout has no devcontainer at its ref, or one tower cannot make a box of (its DevcontainerFellBack condition says why), with its add-ons layered on: workstream sends the repository's boxImage or its own default, as its setup "auto" falls back to them. Empty is tower's --default-box-image; a box with neither fails. Not with image or image_build.

image.description: An explicit base image, which skips the first checkout's devcontainer. At most one of image and image_build is set.

imageBuild.description: An image built for the box from a Dockerfile, with its add-ons layered on, as a container blueprint is, which skips the first checkout's devcontainer. At most one of image and image_build is set.

keep.description: Never stopped for idleness while set: workstream's keep_box. A box with a process running (EnvironmentService.StartProcess) is not either.

privilegedSecrets.description: Values of Secrets in the same project that reach every command and process run in the box, as environment variables named by their as; none is not privileged. The values never enter a spec of a lower layer (docs/decisions/secrets.md).

runState.description: RUN_STATE_STOPPED when workstream hibernates the box. Stopping it ends every process running in it.

secretFiles.description: Values of Secrets in the same project written into the box as files, at each start of its instance and before any command runs in it.

workstream.description: The workstream the box belongs to, by id. A workstream's boxes and machines share a network and reach each other by alias.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.BoxStatus.description: BoxStatus is what tower reports about the box.

alias.description: Its name on the workstream's network.

conditions.description: Ready, with ImageBuilt and Materialized on the way to it; SetUp, which says whether its devcontainer's setup steps passed: one that did not leaves the box READY; and DevcontainerFellBack, true when its image is the one to fall back to, saying why.

imageGolden.description: The Goldens it was made from: its image, and the warm checkout it was cloned from if its repository had one.

lastUseTime.description: When it was last used through tower, to within a minute: what idleness is measured from.

phase.description:
BoxPhase is where a box is in its life.

- BOX_PHASE_PENDING: Waiting for its turn.
- BOX_PHASE_UNPLACED: Its project has no Placement.
- BOX_PHASE_BUILDING: Its image or golden is being built.
- BOX_PHASE_STARTING: Its instance is being made or started.
- BOX_PHASE_STOPPED: Stopped, its disk kept; stopped_reason says why.
- BOX_PHASE_FAILED: It cannot be made; the Ready condition says why.

stoppedReason.description: Why a STOPPED box stopped: "Requested" (run_state) or "Idle".

tower.environments.v1alpha1.Checkout.description: Checkout is one repository checked out in a box.

ref.description: A branch, tag or commit; empty is the repository's default branch.

repository.description: A Repository in the same project, by name.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.ImageBuild.description: ImageBuild is a box image's own build: a Dockerfile and the files its context holds beside it, 16 MiB in all at most.

files.description: The context's files by their relative path, such as "etc/app.conf"; never "Dockerfile".

tower.environments.v1alpha1.Resources.description: Resources is a shape, as quantities; an empty one takes tower's default.

disk.description: Such as "40Gi"; a disk only grows.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.SecretFile.description: SecretFile is one value of a Secret written into a box as a file. The value enters no object, status, log or event, nor any disk: it is held in memory in the box, its path a link to it (docs/decisions/secrets.md).

path.description: Where in the box, an absolute path.

secret.description: A Secret in the same project.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.SecretRef.description: SecretRef names one value of a Secret and what to call it.

as.description: The variable the value is given as.

secret.description: A Secret in the same project.

tower.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

tower.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

tower.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: Box is a working copy an agent edits, builds and runs things in: one or more repositories checked out in a container on the project's target. workstream applies it and watches it; tower decides the rest. A box tower stopped for idleness keeps this object and runs again on its next use. See docs/decisions/declarative-api.md.
title: Box
